user_intent: Requesting a serial dilution protocol to run on a Hamilton STAR liquid handler.
primary_api_or_format: Hamilton VENUS Method Editor (.med) with HSL/VB-style scripting

tools.name: PyHamilton
capabilities: simulate robot session with simulate=True (no physical hardware)
validate Python syntax at run time
basic API-usage validation via simulated run/dry-run
tools.notes: Open-source Python API for Hamilton STAR/STARlet. Supports running in simulation mode to dry-run methods without a connected robot. Requires Hamilton VENUS software installed on Windows; not an official Hamilton product.
